title: Characterising cardiac tissue properties with graph neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.15843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Characterising electrophysiological properties of cardiac tissue efficiently and accurately from spatially sparse intracardiac measurements is clinically important for localising ablation targets and improving arrhythmia treatment. We developed a graph neural network-based framework trained on synthetic electrogram signals on 2D flat surfaces to identify areas of interest in the context of cardiac ablation for premature ventricular complexes (PVCs). Our method achieved an average precision of 0.96, 0.97, and 0.95 for the detection of single-patch fibrosis, rapid depolarisation and high excitability, respectively. The trained model can then be applied to 2D curved surfaces with few-shot fine-tuning, demonstrating its generalisation capability. Future work will develop this framework further for clinical use in PVC ablation.

translated_title: 利用图神经网络表征心脏组织特性
translated_abstract: 摘要：从空间稀疏的心内测量中高效且准确地表征心脏组织的电生理特性，在临床上对于定位消融靶点和改善心律失常治疗具有重要意义。我们开发了一个基于图神经网络的框架，在二维平坦表面上的合成心电图上进行训练，以识别室性早搏（PVC）心脏消融背景下的感兴趣区域。我们的方法在检测单斑块纤维化、快速去极化和高兴奋性方面分别达到了0.96、0.97和0.95的平均精度。训练后的模型可以通过少样本微调应用于二维曲面，展示了其泛化能力。未来工作将进一步开发该框架，用于PVC消融的临床实践。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于图神经网络的框架，能从稀疏心内测量中高精度识别心脏组织异常区域，并具有跨曲面泛化能力，为室性早搏消融治疗提供了新的辅助工具。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a graph neural network-based framework that accurately identifies abnormal cardiac tissue regions from sparse intracardiac measurements, with cross-surface generalization capability, offering a new tool for premature ventricular complex ablation treatment.
